description: This data is published by Peng, Zhen; Yao, Wanxiang. It describes reproduction materials for a Qingdao rooftop-photovoltaic and building-stock carbon study, including supporting tables and model-input documentation. Coverage is city within CN. Spatial resolution is not established here. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists ZIP; these files were not downloaded. Licence: cc-by-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. Reuse beyond the original study remains a scope decision; current execution and completeness were not tested. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
